value.body: Computer Science & Engineering covers how software and computers work: programming, data structures and algorithms, operating systems, databases, computer networks, theory of computation and compilers, plus electives such as machine learning, security and cloud. It leads to software jobs, research and higher study, and it is the largest engineering branch in India by enrolment.

items.label: Course length
items.note: 8 semesters; diploma holders can join year 2 through lateral entry

value.title: How you get in
value.body: You choose the branch at counselling, after the entrance exam. JEE Advanced rank is used for IITs; JEE Main rank for NITs, IIITs and other centrally funded institutes — all allotted through JoSAA. State colleges use state counselling with a state CET (EAMCET, MHT-CET, KCET, WBJEE and others) or, in Tamil Nadu (TNEA), Class 12 marks. Private universities may run their own tests. Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics is required. CSE seats usually fill first and have the most competitive cut-offs, so a given rank gets CSE at fewer colleges than other branches.

value.title: At a glance
items: Much of the syllabus overlaps with IT and AI & ML; recruiters often treat these branches alike.
Hiring depends heavily on coding skill, projects and internships, not just the degree.
Outcomes vary widely between colleges, so look at each college's own placement record.
GATE (CS paper) leads to M.Tech and some PSU jobs; many graduates also go abroad for an MS.
